results.title: CubeSat Model Based System Engineering (MBSE) Reference Model-Application in the Concept Lifecycle Phase
results.abstract: Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) is a key practice to advance systems engineering that can benefit CubeSat missions. MBSE involves creating a system model that is a single source for system engineering such as architecture development and interface management. The system model also integrates other discipline specific engineering models and simulations.
